# Flaim Fantasy

> Flaim connects your real ESPN, Yahoo, and Sleeper fantasy leagues to the AI assistants you already use, so the advice is about your team—not generic fantasy takes.

## What Flaim does

- Connects real fantasy league data to supported AI assistants
- Supports ESPN and Yahoo across football, baseball, basketball, hockey
- Supports Sleeper for football and basketball
- Supplies roster, standings, matchups, free agents, transactions, player, league-setting, and history context
- Uses nine read-only analysis tools plus a bounded Refresh that updates Flaim's own connected-league records
- Available as Flaim Fantasy in ChatGPT and Claude; Perplexity can connect through its current remote-connector settings
- Read-only — Flaim cannot make trades, add or drop players, edit lineups, or change anything in ESPN, Yahoo, or Sleeper
- Free, with no Flaim subscription

## How to connect

1. Create an account at https://flaim.app
2. Connect your fantasy leagues at https://flaim.app/leagues (private ESPN leagues via Chrome extension, Yahoo via OAuth, Sleeper via username)
3. Connect your AI app, authorize Flaim, and ask what fantasy leagues you have (open Flaim Fantasy in ChatGPT or Claude, or follow the Perplexity connection instructions)

After connecting, Your Leagues is where users can add leagues, sync seasons, and choose optional defaults.
